bridge-smoke.stdout:
usage: python -m goldbot.ops.run bridge-smoke [-h] [--state STATE] account

One minimum-lot round trip on a DEMO terminal through the MT5 bridge, after one owner click
(BACKLOG 1). Stop the engine first; keep the supervisor running. Exit 0 ok, 2 not demo, 3 not
approved, 4 precondition, 5 LEFT OPEN, 6 UNKNOWN, 7 RiskGate refused.

positional arguments:
  account

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --state STATE  state directory (default: state)

monthly-report.stdout:

Monthly north-star report (BACKLOG 26, backend; ADR 0004 section 6), from the closed-trade record

options:

owner-history.stdout:

                                               [--targets TARGETS] [--start-balance START_BALANCE]
                                               [--out OUT] [--no-news]
                                               [path]

Analyse the owner's MT5 trade history privately (research seeds).

positional arguments:
  path                  report file, or a folder (newest report in it); default ~/Personal

Performance report for the performance-analyst and finance-auditor agents (north-star: ADR 0004

ruin.stdout:
usage: run.py ruin [-h]
                   [--closed-trades CLOSED_TRADES | --shadow SHADOW | --r-file R_FILE | --win-rate WIN_RATE]
                   [--avg-win AVG_WIN] [--avg-loss AVG_LOSS] [--agent AGENT] [--version VERSION]
                   [--pool-versions] [--models-dir MODELS_DIR] --trades-per-week TRADES_PER_WEEK
                   [--weeks WEEKS] [--horizons [HORIZONS ...]] [--paths PATHS] [--block BLOCK]
                   [--seed SEED] [--risk RISK] [--tiny-live] [--multiplier MULTIPLIER]
                   [--r-haircut R_HAIRCUT] [--demean] [--no-rules] [--ruin-level RUIN_LEVEL]
                   [--settings SETTINGS] [--out OUT]

Drawdown and risk-of-ruin Monte Carlo (G-5).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --closed-trades CLOSED_TRADES
                        state dir with closed_trades*.jsonl (paper/live R, net)
  --shadow SHADOW       state dir with shadow_book.json (one version's taken closed trades)
  --r-file R_FILE       backtest trades, CSV or Parquet with a column r
  --win-rate WIN_RATE   parametric (with --avg-win and --avg-loss)
  --avg-win AVG_WIN     average win in R (parametric)
  --avg-loss AVG_LOSS   average loss in R, positive (parametric)
  --agent AGENT         only this agent's trades (closed-trade and shadow sources)
  --version VERSION     shadow-book version (default: the agent's champion)
  --pool-versions       pool every shadow-book version (champion and challengers)
  --models-dir MODELS_DIR
                        model registry folder (default: settings)
  --trades-per-week TRADES_PER_WEEK
  --weeks WEEKS
  --horizons [HORIZONS ...]
                        weeks to report P(trip) within (default 26 52)
  --paths PATHS
  --block BLOCK         bootstrap block length in trades
  --seed SEED
  --risk RISK           risk per trade (default: settings risk.risk_per_trade)
  --tiny-live           use risk.risk_per_trade_tiny_live
  --multiplier MULTIPLIER
                        model multiplier (clamped like the gate)
  --r-haircut R_HAIRCUT
                        subtract this R from every trade
  --demean              remove the source's mean R (zero-edge stress run)
  --no-rules            measure the limits without enforcing them
  --ruin-level RUIN_LEVEL
  --settings SETTINGS
  --out OUT             write the report as JSON

usage: goldbot run setup [-h] [--account ACCOUNT]

Guided setup of secrets and server settings.

options:

  --account ACCOUNT  the MT5 account this server trades (default icm-demo)

sizing-feasibility.stdout:
usage: run.py sizing-feasibility [-h] [--price PRICE] [--stop-distance STOP_DISTANCE] [--atr ATR]
                                 [--stop-atr STOP_ATR] [--risk RISK] [--tiny-live]
                                 [--multiplier MULTIPLIER] [--size-down] [--equity EQUITY]
                                 [--contract CONTRACT] [--min-lot MIN_LOT] [--lot-step LOT_STEP]
                                 [--stops-level-points STOPS_LEVEL_POINTS]
                                 [--spread-points SPREAD_POINTS] [--data-root DATA_ROOT]
                                 [--timeframes [TIMEFRAMES ...]] [--settings SETTINGS] [--out OUT]

Minimum equity at which the minimum lot fits the risk per trade (G-7).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --price PRICE         price; without it, price and ATR come from the store's bars
  --stop-distance STOP_DISTANCE
                        stop distance in $/oz
  --atr ATR             ATR in $/oz (with --stop-atr)
  --stop-atr STOP_ATR   stop in ATRs (with --atr; from the store: override every family's own)
  --risk RISK           risk per trade (default: settings risk.risk_per_trade)
  --tiny-live           use risk.risk_per_trade_tiny_live
  --multiplier MULTIPLIER
                        model multiplier (clamped like the gate)
  --size-down           the 8% stage: risk halved, multiplier capped at 0.5
  --equity EQUITY       also report lots and real risk at this equity
  --contract CONTRACT
  --min-lot MIN_LOT
  --lot-step LOT_STEP
  --stops-level-points STOPS_LEVEL_POINTS
                        broker stops level (stop floor)
  --spread-points SPREAD_POINTS
                        spread for the stop floor (default: the last bar's mean spread in store
                        mode, else 0)
  --data-root DATA_ROOT
                        store root (default: settings data_root)
  --timeframes [TIMEFRAMES ...]
                        only these decision timeframes (store mode)
  --settings SETTINGS
  --out OUT             write the rows as JSON

tv-import.stdout:
usage: run.py tv-import [-h] --indicator INDICATOR --version VERSION --tf TF [--symbol SYMBOL]
                        [--tz TZ] [--assume-utc] [--data-root DATA_ROOT] [--now NOW]
                        csv

Import a TradingView 'Export chart data' CSV (history for backtests; unvalidated until tv-repaint-
check passes).

positional arguments:
  csv

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --indicator INDICATOR
  --version VERSION
  --tf TF               chart timeframe: 15, 60, 240, 1D
  --symbol SYMBOL
  --tz TZ               IANA timezone of the chart's times when the file has none
                        (America/New_York); DST-aware
  --assume-utc          the file's zoneless times are UTC (chart set to UTC)
  --data-root DATA_ROOT
                        store root (default: settings data_root)
  --now NOW             clock override for tests (ISO time)

tv-repaint-check.stdout:
usage: run.py tv-repaint-check [-h] --indicator INDICATOR --version VERSION --tf TF
                               [--symbol SYMBOL] [--min-bars MIN_BARS] [--agree AGREE]
                               [--abs-tol ABS_TOL] [--origin {csv,pull_history}] [--report-only]
                               [--data-root DATA_ROOT]

Compare a TradingView chart export with the live alerts on the same bars; flag it
repaint_validated above the threshold.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --indicator INDICATOR
  --version VERSION
  --tf TF
  --symbol SYMBOL
  --min-bars MIN_BARS
  --agree AGREE         share of overlapping bars that must match (0.99)
  --abs-tol ABS_TOL
  --origin {csv,pull_history}
                        which history to check: the chart export (csv) or the direct pull
                        (pull_history)
  --report-only         do not change repaint_validated
  --data-root DATA_ROOT
                        store root (default: settings data_root)

help.stdout:
Service entry points used by NSSM on the VPS and by hand in development.

  python -m goldbot.ops.run supervisor
  python -m goldbot.ops.run engine <account_id>
  python -m goldbot.ops.run api
  python -m goldbot.ops.run webhook
  python -m goldbot.ops.run scheduler
  python -m goldbot.ops.run telegram
  python -m goldbot.ops.run news
  python -m goldbot.ops.run record-gate <gate_name> --evidence <path or text>   # appends to state/phase_state.json
  python -m goldbot.ops.run gates [--json] [--no-write]   # each roadmap gate met / not met + the stop rule (records nothing)
  python -m goldbot.ops.run gate-evidence <name> (--value X | --passed yes|no) [--detail TEXT]   # leakage audit, chaos drill
  python -m goldbot.ops.run health [--json] [--static] [--out FILE] [--baseline FILE]   (exit 1 on a fail)
  python -m goldbot.ops.run publish-costs [--out FILE]   # canonical broker's measured costs -> release costs-v1
  python -m goldbot.ops.run backup [--init]              # encrypted restic backup now (--init: create the repository once)
  python -m goldbot.ops.run restore --latest --to DIR    # restore the latest backup into an empty DIR and verify it
  python -m goldbot.ops.run restore-drill                # the weekly restore drill, now
  python -m goldbot.ops.run setup [--account ID]         # guided setup of secrets and server settings (re-runnable)
  python -m goldbot.ops.run preflight [--account ID]     # read-only checklist before starting services (exit 1 on a blocker)
  python -m goldbot.ops.run ruin --trades-per-week N (--closed-trades state | --shadow state | --r-file F | --win-rate ..)
                                                         # drawdown / risk-of-ruin Monte Carlo at the live limits (G-5)
  python -m goldbot.ops.run sizing-feasibility [--equity E] [--tiny-live] [--price P --stop-distance D]
                                                         # minimum equity for the minimum lot per family (G-7)
  python -m goldbot.ops.run revoke-sessions [--state DIR]  # sign every dashboard account out (a stolen session)
  python -m goldbot.ops.run mail-test                    # one test email to auth.owner_email (email sign-in setup)
  python -m goldbot.ops.run monthly-report [--state DIR] [--month YYYY-MM] [--json]
                                                         # time-weighted % return, R, drawdown, avg per day, milestones
  python -m goldbot.ops.run owner-history [PATH]         # the owner's MT5 history -> private report + research seeds
  python -m goldbot.ops.run perf-report [--state DIR] [--data-root DIR] [--from D] [--to D] [--out DIR] [--json]
                                                         # performance report (markdown + JSON) for the analysts; read only
  python -m goldbot.ops.run bridge-smoke <account_id> [--state DIR]
                                                         # demo only: one minimum-lot round trip after one owner click
                                                         # (engine stopped, supervisor running; RUNBOOK "bridge smoke")
  python -m goldbot.ops.run tv-import <csv> --indicator NAME --version V --tf 15|60|240|1D [--symbol XAUUSD]
                                                         # TradingView "Export chart data" CSV -> tv_indicators (unvalidated)
  python -m goldbot.ops.run tv-repaint-check --indicator NAME --version V --tf TF [--report-only]
                                                         # CSV vs live alerts on the same bars; flags repaint_validated
